facts.text: Audrey is using positive reinforcement techniques to address the issue with the dogs.

evidence.quote: The behaviorist gave me tips on how to handle it and suggested some changes in their routine. I'm using positive reinforcement techniques and it's still a work in progress, but I'm hopeful it'll help.
It won't be fixed immediately but I'm seeing some progress.

facts.text: Audrey is devoted to keeping the dogs healthy and happy.

evidence.quote: I'm devoted to keeping them healthy and happy - they mean everything to me.

facts.text: Audrey is hopeful that the current approach will help the dogs return to normal.

evidence.quote: I'm looking forward the day they are back to normal.

facts.text: Audrey shared a photo of the dogs having fun last summer.

evidence.quote: Here's a pic of them having a blast last summer, so happy!
